one_line: Major tech companies face financial and political pressures as AI spending patterns shift and new data center restrictions emerge.

themes.title: Major funding rounds meet market turbulence
themes.text: Anthropic is proceeding with November IPO plans aiming to raise up to $100 billion, while OpenAI closed $11 billion in funding at a $1.25 trillion valuation. Meanwhile, global tech stocks plunged following reports of slowing AI spending and potential regulatory delays for data centers, and Microsoft offered voluntary buyouts to 60,000 employees.

stories.headline: Anthropic presses on with November IPO plans despite global AI stock sell-off
OpenAI closes $11 billion in funding at $1.25 trillion valuation
Asian tech stocks plunge amid fears US Democrats may delay data centers
Ramp data shows AI spending stalling just as Anthropic nears its IPO
Microsoft offers voluntary buyouts to 60,000 employees as AI spending grows

themes.title: Data center expansion faces new restrictions
themes.text: Following US midterm election results, voters passed 40 out of 41 ballot measures to restrict data center development as tech companies and environmental groups negotiate a national framework. Concurrently, Google acquired a Wyoming data center site from Crusoe.

stories.headline: Asian tech stocks plunge amid fears US Democrats may delay data centers
U.S. midterm elections bring voter backlash and new restrictions for AI data centers
Google acquires southeast Wyoming data center site from Crusoe
Big tech and environmental groups negotiate national data center framework

themes.title: Research systems achieve mathematical proofs
themes.text: Physical Superintelligence announced an AI system that proved the Aaronson-Ambainis conjecture using a non-public Anthropic model. Additionally, research indicated that Anthropic is developing AI systems twice as fast as last year, while data showed AI could handle up to 52% of researcher time.

stories.headline: Physical Superintelligence AI system proves Aaronson-Ambainis conjecture
Anthropic developing AI systems twice as fast as a year ago, report says
Ethan Mollick shares Anthropic data on AI impact across scientific fields

themes.title: Regulators target chip exports and data use
themes.text: US Democrats are preparing tighter oversight of Nvidia's chip exports and financing, and Nvidia now requires Southeast Asian cloud partners to enroll in a chip-tracking program to prevent smuggling. Meta also indefinitely delayed terms that would have allowed AI training on external websites linked on Facebook.

stories.headline: Democrats plan tighter oversight of Nvidia on chip exports and financing
Nvidia requires Southeast Asian cloud partners to enroll in chip‑tracking program
Meta pauses commercial terms update that would have allowed AI training on linked sites
